heading, Meet the Holly Team, level 1

Holly Health was founded with a mission to enable life-long behavioural changes, across physical and mental health, for millions of people who currently have limited support. We want to see a world where people have a better quality of life, and feel empowered to achieve the lifestyle changes they desire.
Our team strongly believes in the approach of combining compassion and psychology, with technology, to support entire population groups to achieve lasting changes.
We are impact driven, love what we do, and are highly motivated to keep improving our service and business, through user-centred design approaches.
